data.message: alright 0.9.1 with hot fix because i forgot the debug menu

Hello, I am writing using a translator, so please excuse any errors. Anyway, the mod is very cool and very useful, but there is a problem. When I downloaded the mod and configured it, I noticed that a Spawn Carl window appeared in the upper left corner, and just below it, a Spawn Cannibal button. I would like to know if it is possible to remove this window? It just gets in the way of the gameplay. Thanks for the mod, it's cool.
